features.description: Project scaffold -- set up the sticker_factory/ package with all module files and update requirements.txt
steps: Create sticker_factory/ directory with __init__.py, config.py, db.py, models.py, renderer.py, publisher.py, cli.py, ideation.py, ascii_gen.py
Create config.yaml with niche, ideation, ascii_generation, and rendering sections per SPEC.md
Update requirements.txt with all needed dependencies (Pillow, click, pyyaml, python-dotenv, requests)
Verify: `python -c "import sticker_factory"` succeeds

features.description: Config loading -- load YAML config file and .env secrets into a unified config object
steps: Implement config.py to load config.yaml using PyYAML
Load .env secrets using python-dotenv (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PRINTIFY_API_KEY)
Provide a get_config() function that returns the merged config
Verify: loading config.yaml returns expected niche, rendering, and ideation settings
Verify: missing .env does not crash (secrets are optional until needed)

features.description: SQLite schema -- create the designs table with all columns from SPEC.md
steps: Implement db.py with init_db() that creates the designs table

Columns: id (INTEGER PK), concept_title (TEXT), concept_brief (TEXT), ascii_art (TEXT), ascii_file_path (TEXT), png_file_paths (JSON), colors (JSON), status (TEXT), printify_product_id (TEXT), etsy_listing_url (TEXT), created_at (DATETIME), updated_at (DATETIME)
Provide helper functions: insert_design, get_design, update_design, list_designs
Verify: init_db() creates the table, insert and retrieve a row successfully

features.description: Data models -- Python dataclasses for Design matching the SQLite schema
steps: Implement models.py with a Design dataclass
Fields match the designs table columns
Include from_row() classmethod to construct from a DB row
Include to_dict() method for serialization
Verify: can create a Design instance, round-trip through to_dict() and from_row()

features.description: Renderer -- refactor ascii2png.py into the renderer module with print-quality sizing
steps: Move core rendering logic from ascii2png.py into sticker_factory/renderer.py
Support configurable font size (200-400px), padding, and background color (white default)
render_ascii_to_png(ascii_text, output_path, font_size, padding, fg_color, bg_color) function
Output PNGs at print quality (2000-4000px on longest side)
Verify: render a sample ASCII art file to PNG, confirm output dimensions are in print-quality range

features.description: Color variations -- render the same ASCII design in multiple color schemes from config
steps: Implement render_variations(ascii_text, output_dir, design_name, color_schemes) in renderer.py
Read color_schemes from config.yaml (each has name, fg, bg)
Output one PNG per color scheme, named like {design_name}_{scheme_name}.png
Verify: given 3 color schemes, produces 3 distinct PNG files with correct colors

features.description: CLI entry point -- `sticker` command with subcommands using click or argparse
steps: Implement cli.py with a main command group and subcommands: render, publish, review
render subcommand: takes an ASCII file path, renders to PNG (with color variations)
Wire up CLI as a console_scripts entry point or a __main__.py so `python -m sticker_factory` works
Verify: `python -m sticker_factory render designs/vibe-coder.txt` produces PNGs in exports/

features.description: Printify API client -- basic API wrapper for authentication, creating products, and uploading images
steps: Implement publisher.py with a PrintifyClient class
Methods: upload_image(image_path) -> image_id, create_product(title, image_id, blueprint_id) -> product_id
Use PRINTIFY_API_KEY from config/env
Handle HTTP errors gracefully with logging
Verify: class instantiates, methods exist with correct signatures (live API test deferred until key is set up)

features.description: Publish command -- CLI subcommand to take a rendered PNG and publish it to Printify as a sticker product
steps: Add publish subcommand to CLI: takes a design ID or PNG path
Uploads image to Printify, creates a product, stores product ID in DB
Updates design status to 'published'
Verify: command runs without error when given valid inputs (end-to-end test deferred until API key exists)

features.description: LLM ideation -- Claude API generates concept briefs (title, description, style hints, colors)
steps: Implement ideation.py with generate_concepts(niche, count) using Claude API
Store generated concepts in SQLite with status 'ideated'
Verify: generates expected number of concept briefs with required fields

features.description: LLM ASCII generation -- Claude API generates ASCII art from concept briefs
steps: Implement ascii_gen.py with generate_ascii(concept_brief) using Claude API
Save generated ASCII art to designs/ directory and update DB
Verify: given a concept brief, produces valid ASCII art text

features.description: AI image generation (GPT/Gemini) -- v2 design method using image generation APIs
steps: Add image generation support via ChatGPT image API or Gemini Imagen
Integrate as alternative to ASCII-to-PNG rendering pipeline
Verify: generates a sticker design image from a concept brief

features.description: Sticker sheet composition -- arrange multiple stickers on a single printable sheet
steps: Implement sheet layout logic to tile multiple sticker PNGs onto one sheet
Configurable sheet size, sticker spacing, and arrangement
Verify: produces a composite PNG with multiple stickers arranged correctly

features.description: Chain pipeline together -- `sticker run` command that executes ideate -> generate -> render -> review -> publish
steps: Implement run subcommand in cli.py that chains all pipeline steps
Pause for manual review step unless --auto flag is passed
Verify: full pipeline runs end-to-end from ideation to publishing

features.description: Cloud deployment + cron scheduling -- deploy pipeline to run on a schedule
steps: Containerize the pipeline or deploy to a cloud VM
Set up cron/launchd/Cloud Scheduler to run daily
Verify: pipeline runs unattended on schedule

features.description: Observability dashboard (TypeScript) -- web UI showing pipeline stats, design statuses, and error rates
steps: Build a TypeScript web app that reads from the SQLite database
Display: designs generated, approved/rejected ratio, published count, error rate
Verify: dashboard renders with live data from the pipeline DB

features.description: Daily digest notifications -- Slack/Discord/email summary of pipeline activity
steps: Implement notification module with Slack/Discord webhook or email support
Send daily summary: new designs, pending reviews, published count, errors
Verify: notification is sent with correct content

features.description: Automated LLM design review -- Claude-based quality check before publishing
steps: Implement LLM-based review that evaluates design quality, readability, and aesthetic appeal
Auto-approve, auto-reject, or flag for human review based on confidence
Verify: given a set of test designs, correctly categorizes quality levels
